name: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction from Density Field
aliases: OpenCL Octree Construction from Density Field
definition: An OpenCL-based pipeline that converts a 3D density field into a compact octree structure by finding active voxels, compacting them, and computing leaf node data (QEF, normals, materials).
summary: This OpenCL pipeline converts 3D density fields into sparse voxel octrees, distinguished by a download-reupload strategy that avoids rendering thread blocking.
